q: What looks unusual in the last 14 days?
answer:
Short answer: traffic and advertising spiked while some P&L sales lines moved oddly — product ad spend +195%, overall ad spend +141% and sessions +96% from 2026-09-18..2026-09-30 to 2026-10-01..2026-10-13, while the finance P&L net sales fell sharply (a large negative swing). This means more marketing activity and site visits, but the P&L picture is inconsistent and needs a finance-side drill.

What changed (ordered by impact)
- Product ad spend (allocated): INR 502,485 (2026-10-01..2026-10-13), +195% vs prior 13 days — big ramp in product-level advertising.
- Ad spend (report_date): INR 708,883, +141% vs prior 13 days — platform ad budgets were much higher this window.
- Sessions: 53,780, +96% vs prior 13 days — site traffic nearly doubled, consistent with higher ad activity.
- Net sales (P&L basis): INR 1,010,822, +75% vs prior 13 days — order-date P&L sales rose materially.
- P&L net sales (finance view/event date): INR 906,860 and the exploration flags a large negative swing vs the prior window (reported as −280% change), i.e. the books moved in a way that contradicts the order-date sales rise and warrants attention.

Worth checking: run a diagnose on P&L net sales (finance P&L net sales) for 2026-10-01..2026-10-13 to find whether returns, cancellations, accounting timing or a posting error explain the negative swing.
